title: Show address lines 1-3 in address lookup display text
summary: The address lookup modal for Ideal Postcodes now displays address lines 1-3 combined in a single text field instead of showing separate address, city, and post code columns.
key_points: Display Text is built from address lines 1-3 (line_1/line_2/line_3) instead of address, city, and post code
Address, City, and Post Code columns are removed from the Select Address modal
Modal page test handler updated to select rows by key instead of the removed Post Code column
Affects the GB Ideal Postcodes integration
